scripts.//: The site is static — demo/ is served as-is. `build` is a deliberate
scripts.///: no-op so a CI build command can't fail on a missing script.
scripts.build: echo "Static site — nothing to build. Assets are committed under demo/assets/."
scripts.build:assets: node scripts/process-video.mjs assets/walkthrough.mp4 && node scripts/process-video.mjs assets/demo.mp4

devDependencies.//: Both are local tooling only. ffmpeg-static downloads an ~80 MB binary
devDependencies.///: on install, so it must never be a runtime dependency — a CI build
devDependencies.////: that runs `npm install` would fetch it for no reason, slowly.
